reproductions.name: axon of passage is highly excitable
reproductions.criterion: axon threshold <= soma threshold, in physiological range
reproductions.note: Diverges from Greenberg 1999's original soma<axon claim; consistent with a proper Na band and the axon-avoidance premise: axons are the low-threshold off-target.

reproductions.name: spike initiates at the sodium-channel band (AIS)
reproductions.criterion: spike initiates in the AIS/proximal-axon region (not soma), near threshold

reproductions.name: strength-duration: threshold falls with pulse width
reproductions.criterion: threshold decreases monotonically with pulse width (<0.5 ms, direct activation)

reproductions.name: cathodic is more excitable than anodic
strength-duration chronaxie is sub-millisecond
reproductions.criterion: chronaxie in 0.05-1.0 ms (direct RGC activation, sub-millisecond)

reproductions.name: local return sharpens the field (selectivity)
reproductions.note: Field-sharpening mechanism reproduces robustly. The full-model somatic threshold-ratio gain is confounded by AIS/dendrite activation in this reduced tier (analytical + mouse RGC) and is deferred to Phase 4 (FEM + primate morphology).

reproductions.name: confined return flattens the axon activating function
reproductions.measured: peak axon AF: monopolar 1.78e-03, confined 1.20e-03 (1.5× lower)
reproductions.criterion: confined-return peak activating function along the axon is below monopolar

reproductions.name: confined return avoids the axon of passage
reproductions.measured: axon threshold: monopolar 17 µA, confined 373 µA

reproductions.name: two subthreshold electrodes jointly fire (current summation)
reproductions.measured: threshold each: A 14, B 14 µA alone; paired 7 µA (51% of single)
reproductions.criterion: paired-electrode threshold falls below either single-electrode threshold
